Summary of the intended cleanup (proposed, not performed)
- Goal: make B2 display as a standardized date (recommended format: yyyy-mm-dd, i.e., 2026-07-01) while leaving:
  - the underlying cell type (a true date serial) intact where possible,
  - formulas (F2 = C2*D2 and G2 = IF(F2>1000,"Review","OK")) untouched,
  - existing currency formatting and any data validation rules preserved.

How to decide what to do (quick check)
- Test whether B2 is already a true date value or plain text:
  - In a spare cell enter: =ISNUMBER(B2)
  - If it returns TRUE → B2 is a date serial (good).
  - If it returns FALSE → B2 is text (needs conversion).

If B2 is already a date (ISNUMBER = TRUE)
1. Change only the number format (no formula or value change):
   - Excel: Home → Number Format → More Number Formats → Custom → type yyyy-mm-dd
   - Google Sheets: Format → Number → More Formats → Custom date and time → choose yyyy-mm-dd
2. Result: B2 will visibly show 2026-07-01 while the underlying value remains a date serial
